target_customer: SaaS product teams that need to offer native user-facing integrations to their customers
problem: Building and maintaining customer-facing SaaS integrations (CRM, accounting, e-commerce) takes heavy engineering time.
business_model: B2B SaaS embedded integration platform with Python-based transformation layer

founders.name: Hassan Syyid
education: Dropped out of the University of Maryland (per press)
founders.background_notes: Press says the idea came from a previous company of his that struggled with native integrations; company not named

founders.name: David Molot
education: Dropped out of the University of Maryland (per press)
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder in press, not listed on the YC page

competitors.name: Prismatic
competitors.what: Embedded integration marketplace for end users

technical_complexity.rationale: Authentication, connectors and a Python transformation layer across many SaaS APIs are standard but broad engineering for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Many embedded iPaaS rivals exist; connectors embedded in a customer's product create some lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copy found; hotglue raised a 4M seed in November 2024.

market_need_then: SaaS vendors needed native integrations; the founder's earlier company struggled with them per press. No dated spend figure found.

brand_strength.rationale: Modest developer brand; no brand press found and the name is shared with an unrelated Australian agency.

outcome_analysis: hotglue raised 1.5M in 2021 from Uncommon Capital and angels, then stayed lean for three years before a 4M seed led by 8VC in November 2024, with a stated goal of a Series A within 18 months. It competes in a crowded embedded iPaaS market and shows no sign of acquisition or shutdown.
notes: Company site and several press pages were rate limited on fetch; round facts come from search snippets of Built In, Technical.ly, company blog and Finsmes, which agree. Some outlets call the 2021 round pre-seed; stage conflicts. Founded year not stated in sources opened. Competitor entries have no dated source; they come from hotglue's own comparison posts and G2. CB Insights total of 5.63M is an aggregator figure.
